name: title
on_screen: Voice Typing Android — Keep Your Keyboard
text: Want voice typing on Android without replacing your keyboard? AI Dictation adds a floating mic beside supported text fields.

name: permissions
text: Setup asks for microphone and Accessibility access so it can find the active field and insert text when you dictate.

name: focus
text: Tap a text field, and the microphone appears while your regular keyboard stays open.

name: dictate
text: Tap the mic, speak, then tap again. When processing finishes, the text is inserted at your cursor.

name: modes
text: Choose optional offline recognition, which may need a model download, or choose cloud transcription in Settings.

name: customize
on_screen: Cleanup · Vocabulary · Writing rules · Spoken shortcuts
text: Cloud features can also apply cleanup, personal vocabulary, writing rules, and spoken shortcuts. Relevant audio or text may be processed remotely.

name: cta
text: AI Dictation is open source. Try it at aidictation dot com, or inspect the code on GitHub.
